g.title: seq
g.text: 05a Release of funds: two separate authorities, allotment (to commit) and cash authority (to pay). Example: FY 2026

a.text: 1. DBM to National agency: Release guidelines
for the year (National Budget Circular)
2. National agency to URS: Budget execution
documents: BED 1 Financial Plan, BED 2
Physical Plan, BED 3 Monthly Disbursement
Program
3. URS to DBM: Documents for evaluation
4. DBM to Operating units: No separate
document. The GAA itself is the allotment
order (GAAAO). Items appropriated to a
regional office or operating unit go directly
to it
5. National agency to DBM: Special Budget
Request with details: project profile,
location, cost, certifications
11. National agency to Operating units: Sub-
allotment to lower units, where the central
office holds the allotment

a.xlink:title: end of: Item without pre-conditions (Schedule I). Example: salaries of filled positions
skip: Item for which the guidelines require it

a.text: 6. DBM to Office of the President: Request for
approval
8. DBM: Evaluate: conditions of the GAA,
readiness, past spending capacity of the
agency
7. Office of the President to DBM: Approval

a.xlink:title: end of: Item for which the guidelines require it

a.text: 9. DBM to ADRS: Approved SARO (Special
Allotment Release Order) or GARO (General
Allotment Release Order)
10. ADRS to National agency: Authorized users
of the agency download the document

a.xlink:title: end of: Item that needs clearance (Schedule II). Examples: lump sums, new items, special purpose funds

a.text: 12. BTr to DBM: Cash position of the national
government
13. DBM to Servicing banks: Notice of Cash
Allocation (NCA). First NCA covers the first
quarter. Later NCAs follow the Monthly
Disbursement Program, subject to spending
performance and the fiscal position
14. Servicing banks: Credit the limit to the
MDS sub-account of the unit: regular, special
accounts, trust, or foreign-assisted projects
15. DBM to ADRS: Advice of NCA Issued
16. ADRS to Operating units: Agency downloads
the advice

a.xlink:title: skip: Cash need above the program

a.text: 17. National agency to DBM: Request for
additional NCA
19. National agency to Operating units: Notice
of Transfer of Allocation, where the central
office shares its own NCA with a lower unit
18. DBM to Servicing banks: Additional NCA

a.xlink:title: end of: Cash need above the program
